name: Cá chiên
summary: Cá chiên is fried fish in the daily rice. The Hội An World Heritage centre’s 16 September 2025 study lists it apart from cá cháy and from grilled dried fish, and says the cooking uses little spice. No fry time and no stall price were printed.
origin: Cham Islands. The daily catch on Tân Hiệp, eaten with rice.
howToEat: With rice, at the midday or evening meal. Lunch is about 11:00–12:00 and the evening meal about 17:00–18:00 on the 16 September 2025 study.
The study does not name a fish or a coating. A current price is Check on arrival.
where: Bai Lang and the other hamlets. The study names no shop.
seoTitle: Cá chiên — fried fish on the Cham Islands
seoDescription: Fried fish in the daily rice on Tân Hiệp, listed apart from cá cháy and grilled dried fish. A stall price is Check on arrival.
